name: Is She Really Going Out with Him?

podcast.body: Jackson's first major pop hit. It is a bitter lament sung by a solitary man pining for a woman he feels he has no chance with. Despite its caustic facade, the song is melodically graceful and romantic. It was first released in late 1978, finally cracking the Hot 100 in June 1979, and by mid-July, it had entered the top 40 on its way to a number 21 peak. "Is she really going out with him."

podcast.body: Joe Jackson's 1988 live album captured three different versions of this classic song, showcasing it in jazz rock, acoustic, and a cappella styles. This reflected Jackson's touring practice of refusing to play old material as originally arranged, a choice that often both confounded and delighted his audiences. "His 1988 live album captured three versions of Ishi really going out with him in three styles, including Jazz Rock, Acoustic, and even Acapilla."
